items.title: MECH-467 H-energy: is 874b's exposure window destroyed by self-contamination or by starvation?
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 PORTFOLIO, 2 legs not 4. The autopsy pre-registered four legs but made the count CONDITIONAL in its section 8a on whether chip-20260816-substrate-navigation-immobility-probe had run. It HAS -- resolved done 2026-08-18T23:53:06Z, AFTER this work was briefed, staging REE_assembly/evidence/planning/navigation_immobility_scoping_2026-08-18.md (origin/master d6206f641a). That spike answers H-commitment and H-cadence at SUBSTRATE level (the near-immobility is the plain-navigation instance of MECH-439 F-dominance conversion ceiling, ceiling_decision exhausted, awaiting ARC-107, amplified by the E3 heartbeat hold-and-repeat cadence e3_steps_per_tick), and the deeper cause is owned by the ACTIVE hypothesis-space line e3_fdominance_causal_discrimination. So the autopsy's own instruction is to shrink to H-energy + H-denominator. Their MEASUREMENTS (approach-run length, e3_tick vs latched fraction) are still instrumented, inside V3-EXQ-941. Full reasoning + the residual registry debt: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/mech467_govfanout_portfolio_staged_2026-08-19.md. | THIS LEG (H-energy, axis family `environment`): 874b's autopsy reads its 7-of-12 health_depleted terminations (63.1% of the pre-registered window realised, recorded nowhere) as the agent having starved. A competing, fully documented mechanism exists that 874b was exposed to and did not opt out of: CausalGridWorldV2 applies contamination_spread (DEFAULT 0.5) to EVERY cell entered regardless of num_hazards; a cell crossing contamination_threshold (2.0) becomes contaminated and drains contaminated_harm (0.4) per contact, so ~3 contacts are lethal from full health. 874b set num_hazards=0 and set NEITHER contamination_spread=0.0 NOR hazard_free_contamination_gate=True. Verified empirically 2026-08-19 on 874b's exact env kwargs: stock binds 0.5, +gate binds 0.0. The same footgun is the motivating incident (V3-EXQ-884) behind the shared SD-094 EpisodeTerminationAccumulator, which this driver feeds and 874b did not use. 3 arms x 3 seeds: ARM_STOCK (874b verbatim) / ARM_CONTAM_OFF (gate on) / ARM_HEALTH_DECOUPLED (gate on + health clamped so the window cannot terminate for health reasons). operating_mode pinned internal_planning in all three, so energy is the only axis. | DECLARED NULL (the autopsy's own wording): event rate per REALISED tick is unchanged -- starvation only shortened the window, it did not suppress eating. | DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, mandatory): DV is a ratio of counts over realised ticks; symmetry group is permutation of ticks. The manipulation changes which ticks exist and whether the terminal fires -- not a broadcast constant, not a monotone rescaling, not a permutation of interchangeable units. NOT invariant in ARM_STOCK, ARM_CONTAM_OFF or ARM_HEALTH_DECOUPLED. | STRUCTURAL VACUITY (785): in ARM_HEALTH_DECOUPLED window_completeness is forced to ~1.0 BY the manipulation, so C1 is owned only by the two arms where it can move and that arm is scored on C2 alone -- disposition (a), not a vacuous arm. | 874b DEFECTS FIXED: (1) done_cause + truncated + realised/budgeted ticks + window_completeness per cell, every rate normalised by REALISED ticks; (2) the ruleset axis is NOT varied (SIMPLE only) so the nutritive-density confound cannot arise, and benefit-bearing cell count is measured off the env type grid and gated; (3) ZGoalStreamAccumulator.observe() called on the STEPPING CLONE, not the P0 base agent -- smoke confirms n_agents=3, writer_calls>0, no writer defect. | STEP 2.5b ADVERSARIAL DESIGN AUDIT (2026-08-19, pre-queue) found and fixed a verdict-aliasing defect here: C1 reads a LIFT in window completeness, so if ARM_STOCK never truncated the lift is ~0 and C1 would read FALSE, ALIASING 'contamination was not the cause' onto 'there was no truncation to explain'. C1's non-degeneracy is now keyed to ARM_STOCK actually truncating, and that case routes to the explicit truncation_not_reproduced_c1_undiscriminating label instead of to a null. | Smoke PASS; validate_experiments --strict 1 OK / 0 warnings across all 30 checks. NOT a lettered re-pose of 874b (the autopsy refuses one) and `supersedes` is deliberately NOT set: this is a diagnostic about why 874b's denominator vanished, not a re-run of its test, and 874b is already non_contributory carrying no weight. | GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): decisive readouts done_cause / window_completeness / n_approach_initiations / n_position_changes searched across all 922 flat manifests in REE_assembly/evidence/experiments -- ZERO carry any of them (the 874b autopsy says so directly: 'the env exposes done_cause in info; the driver never reads it'), so not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. | SUBSTRATE-DEFECT GATE (step 2.5c): two open `corrupting` substrate_queue entries overlap modules this driver imports, and BOTH were judged non-reaching rather than blocking -- recorded here per the `degrading` disposition so any later autopsy sees it. (a) mode-governance-engagement (salience_coordinator.py, config.py, agent.py): its own severity_note scopes the corrupting defect to experiments/_lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py's min-across-arms/band gate pattern, which this driver does not use (it uses precondition_gate.py with per-arm applies_to scoping); its external_task drive is default-off and unused here, and this design PINS operating_mode, discarding the coordinator's computed mode by construction. (b) contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py): its severity_rationale scopes the hazard to a consumer whose null 'looks like a genuine no-effect finding'; this leg produces no null of that shape -- it decomposes a denominator, and the current ContextMemory behaviour is part of the substrate condition under test (874b ran under it too). The fix landed 2026-08-19 default-OFF, so behaviour here is the legacy path. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): MECH-467 count = 1 against threshold 2 -- does not fire. | ETHICS PREFLIGHT (step 2.6): all-false, decision allow.

items.title: MECH-467 H-denominator: decompose '0 consumption events' into never-approached vs approached-and-failed-to-arrive
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 PORTFOLIO, 2 legs not 4. The autopsy pre-registered four legs but made the count CONDITIONAL in its section 8a on whether chip-20260816-substrate-navigation-immobility-probe had run. It HAS -- resolved done 2026-08-18T23:53:06Z, AFTER this work was briefed, staging REE_assembly/evidence/planning/navigation_immobility_scoping_2026-08-18.md (origin/master d6206f641a). This leg builds the missing upstream instrument, and its key property is that EVERY counter is measurable on a window in which nothing is ever eaten. Counters: n_move_actions vs n_position_changes (their gap is the wall-blocking no-op rate the scoping spike flags as an additive contributor), n_approach_initiations (a step strictly reducing Chebyshev distance to the nearest benefit-bearing cell), approach_run_lengths (consecutive decreasing steps toward the SAME target -- H-commitment's measurement, kept as instrumentation), n_arrivals, min/mean distance, n_e3_ticks vs n_latched_ticks (H-cadence's measurement), done_cause, window_completeness. 2 arms x 3 seeds: ARM_PRECOMMIT (internal_planning) / ARM_REPLAY (internal_replay); the during-commitment arm is excluded per MECH-467's SEQUENCING CAUTION. | DECLARED NULL (the autopsy's own wording): the decomposition is uninformative because approaches are initiated and complete at the observed rate. | READ THE LABEL, NOT THE OUTCOME: outcome PASS is the NULL (pipeline intact end to end). A FAIL is the INFORMATIVE result -- it localises where the denominator is lost. combination_rule records this explicitly. | READINESS, SAME-STATISTIC (643): the load-bearing criterion routes on COUNTS OF POSITION CHANGE, so the positive control asserts that same statistic -- forced cardinal moves on a fresh env must change the agent's cell (measured 2026-08-19: 4 of 4). Below floor self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a substrate verdict. | DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, mandatory): DV is a ratio of counts of distance-decreasing steps; symmetry group is permutation of ticks. The manipulation is the operating-mode pin, which changes the SELECTION POLICY and hence which actions are taken -- not a broadcast scalar across candidates, not a monotone rescaling preserving candidate order, not a permutation of interchangeable units. NOT invariant in either arm. | 874b DEFECTS FIXED: same three as V3-EXQ-940 (window recorded incl. done_cause; ruleset axis not varied so the nutritive-density confound cannot arise; z_goal accumulator observes the STEPPING CLONE -- smoke confirms n_agents=2, no writer defect). | STEP 2.5b ADVERSARIAL DESIGN AUDIT (2026-08-19, pre-queue) found and fixed TWO defects here. (i) COVERAGE/ALIASING: arrival is geometric (distance 0) while a consumption event is the env's own sd049 tag, so a run that reliably ARRIVES and never EATS would have satisfied C1 and C2 and routed to the DECLARED NULL, hiding a defect one step downstream of everything this leg was built to see. Added load-bearing C3_arrivals_convert_to_consumption and the denominator_lost_at_consumption route. (ii) ALIASING: with 12 resources on a 6x6 grid the mean distance to a target is small, and at distance 0 no strict decrease is possible -- so a near-zero mean distance would drive approach_initiation_rate to ~0 and ALIAS onto the `never_approached` verdict while meaning the opposite (the agent was already there). Added the approach_is_definable readiness precondition. | Smoke PASS; validate_experiments --strict 1 OK / 0 warnings across all 30 checks.
